title: A Message About a Found Item
instructions: Write your own first draft, submit it, and use the feedback to revise it.
prompt: Write 100–140 words to a real or imagined office worker about an item you found. Explain where you found it, what you did with it, one polite request, and why the owner can ask the office for help. Explain how to check who owns a lost item before returning it.
